articles.title: Outside the Scope of Our Support
articles.summary: When Google's support team asked for a workaround to fix a bug that kills touch exploration for every screen reader on Android, the author was initially happy to provide a simple solution by turning TalkBack off and on again, clearing the cache of an app, and rebooting. However, the issue persisted, and the author took a more in-depth approach, capturing log buffers and working out the root cause of the problem, which involved a dragging state with no valid pointer, a MotionEvent exception, and a verifier that is only thrown away when a display is removed. The author then developed two patches, one for the accessibility code and one for the input dispatcher, which were sent back to the case along with a request for further assistance. The author's solution was met with a more detailed and accurate response from the support team, which acknowledged the root cause and provided a recovery method, further emphasizing the importance of addressing the underlying issue.
